notes.title: Bug fixes
notes.notes: Some people have reported problems with the beat marker disappearing, or keeping on going for too long. There appeared to be an issue when using a gamepad that caused that to happened, it should be fixed now. So sorry for the inconvenience, if it still happens for any one, please let me know.
